finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 section into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Out of 380 commits, 14 matter.

Three break things. Internal error types stopped being re-exported. The v1 export route is gone. An expired token now returns `401`, not `403`.

One new feature. Webhook retries with backoff.

Ten distinct fixes, deduped from repeats across modules. Biggest are the null cursor crash, the empty allowlist acting as allow-all, and request bodies in logs.

I left perf work out. Four real wins, but your file has no heading for them. Say the word and I add a line.
